text: Since a photonic spiking network is event-driven with E_total ~ (number of spikes) x (energy per spike), the widely cited energy target for a competitive photonic spiking neuron is less than ___ per spike.
explanation: Present laser-neuron demonstrations sit in the femtojoule-to-picojoule range, with a widely cited goal of less than 1 fJ per spike (plus sub-pJ to pJ for O-E-O conversion). Because energy is spikes times energy-per-spike, sub-fJ dynamic energy per event is the design goal.
